newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-ProSource cut after warning.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ProSource cut after warning.

text.p: Smith Barney cut its rating of ProSource Inc, according to a source at the brokerage, after the food service distributor said it expected quarterly earnings to fall below last year's levels.

-- The Coral Gables company, which distributes food to chain restaurants including Burger King, Wendy's, Red Lobster and TGI Friday said late Monday earnings for the second quarter ending June 28 would be "significantly lower" than the $0.23 it posted in the second quarter of 1996.
-- It said earnings could fall by $0.25 to $0.30 a share, which could mean a loss for the company.
-- The company went public in November at $14 a share.
-- Shares closed on Monday on the Nasdaq at 12-5/8.
-- ProSource cited costs associated with the termination of its Arby's contract and price increases for vehicle maintenance and weaker-than-expected sales growth.
